_meta.description: Active Verra VCS methodologies relevant to waste-to-energy and related project types
_meta.refresh_process: Download current methodology list from Verra registry; update IDs, versions, and applicability conditions

methodologies.name: Alternative Waste Treatment Processes
applicability_conditions: The project activity involves treatment of waste that would have been disposed in a solid waste disposal site (SWDS) in the baseline scenario
The project activity uses one or more of: composting, anaerobic digestion, gasification, RDF production, or other alternative waste treatment
The waste treated in the project activity is not exclusively composed of biomass residues from agricultural activities
Methane recovery and destruction is not included in the baseline scenario
The project activity does not include co-firing of fossil fuels above 50% of total energy input on an annual basis

methodologies.name: Emissions Reduction Through Partial Substitution of Fossil Fuels with Alternative Fuels or Less Carbon Intensive Fuels in Cement or Quickite Manufacture
applicability_conditions: The project involves partial substitution of fossil fuels used in an existing cement or quicklite manufacturing facility
The alternative fuel used is biomass residue, refuse derived fuel, or other waste-derived fuel
The alternative fuel is not used in the baseline scenario at the project facility
The project does not involve new cement manufacturing capacity

methodologies.name: Electricity and Heat Generation from Biomass
applicability_conditions: The project generates electricity and/or heat using biomass as fuel
The biomass is from renewable sources (agricultural residues, forestry residues, or purpose-grown biomass)
The project displaces fossil fuel-based electricity and/or heat generation
The project does not involve switching from one fossil fuel to another

methodologies.name: Avoided Emissions from Organic Waste Through Alternative Waste Treatment Processes
applicability_conditions: The project activity avoids methane emissions from disposal of organic waste at a SWDS
Waste used in the project would have been disposed in a SWDS in the absence of the project
The project uses composting, anaerobic digestion, or other biological treatment
The project does not involve combustion or thermal treatment of waste

methodologies.name: Avoidance of Methane Production from Decay of Biomass Through Controlled Combustion, Gasification or Mechanical/Thermal Treatment
applicability_conditions: The project avoids methane from biomass decay through controlled combustion or thermal treatment
Project is small-scale (emission reductions <= 60,000 tCO2e/year)
Waste would have been left to decay in the absence of the project
The project does not involve fossil fuel co-firing above 50%

methodologies.name: Avoidance of Methane Emissions Through Composting
applicability_conditions: The project avoids methane through aerobic composting of organic waste
Project is small-scale (emission reductions <= 60,000 tCO2e/year)
Waste would have been disposed in a SWDS in the baseline
The composting process produces stabilized compost

methodologies.name: Methane Recovery in Wastewater Treatment
applicability_conditions: The project recovers and destroys methane from wastewater treatment
Project is small-scale (emission reductions <= 60,000 tCO2e/year)
Methane would have been released to atmosphere in the baseline
The project uses anaerobic treatment followed by methane capture

methodologies.name: Flaring or Use of Landfill Gas
applicability_conditions: The project captures and combusts or uses landfill gas from an existing SWDS
No landfill gas capture and destruction exists in the baseline
The landfill is not required by regulation to capture and destroy LFG
The captured gas is combusted in a flare, engine, turbine, or boiler

methodologies.name: Methodology for Carbon Accounting for Mosaic and Landscape-scale REDD Projects
applicability_conditions: The project reduces emissions from deforestation and forest degradation
The project area is in a tropical or subtropical region
Deforestation and degradation are occurring in the baseline
